name: usshtc107
description: USTC computing platform SSH proxy client
author: Enthusjast <enthusjast@outlook.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "vite --port 5173" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=true electron ."
scripts.check: npm run check:electron && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:electron: node --check electron/auth-state.js && node --check electron/constants.js && node --check electron/credential-store.js && node --check electron/log-redaction.js && node --check electron/login-navigation.js && node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check electron/proxy-server.js && node --check electron/settings-store.js && node --check electron/shutdown-coordinator.js && node --check electron/ssh-config-service.js && node --check electron/ssh-key-service.js
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:node:coverage && npm run test:ui:coverage
scripts.build:mac-icon: set -eu; iconset=build/icon.iconset; mkdir -p "$iconset"; for size in 16 32 128 256 512; do double=$((size * 2)); sips -z "$size" "$size" build/icon.png --out "$iconset/icon_${size}x${size}.png" >/dev/null; sips -z "$double" "$double" build/icon.png --out "$iconset/icon_${size}x${size}@2x.png" >/dev/null; done; iconutil -c icns "$iconset" -o build/icon.icns
scripts.dist:mac: vite build && npm run build:mac-icon && electron-builder --mac
